actions.title: Begin with no Body
actions.what_happened: One exact Host boot began a bounded bootstrap from truthful zero-Body state.
actions.what_conduit_established: Absence and the start of bootstrap were both retained, rather than inferred from later Birth.

actions.title: Birth and become usable
actions.what_happened: The bootstrap created a new Body and admitted its first wake.
actions.what_conduit_established: Birth and usability are exact lifecycle truth for this independent Body.

actions.title: Do useful work
actions.what_happened: The Body exercised already admitted semantic work.
actions.what_conduit_established: An exact Plan and Play performed useful work; embodiment-specific inspection or revision may remain in detailed receipts.

actions.title: Inspect the initial Show
actions.what_happened: The Body inspected its exact current Face, Mask route, Plan, and Show.
actions.what_conduit_established: The initial human-facing realization is producer evidence, not an inferred screenshot label.

actions.title: Wear an alternate Mask
actions.what_happened: The Body made a second ordinary Mask Form eligible in its revisioned wardrobe.
actions.what_conduit_established: Eligibility changed without mutating the immutable body-wide Plan.

actions.title: Prefer the alternate Mask
actions.what_happened: The Body preferred and selected an already-sealed alternate Mask route.
actions.what_conduit_established: Selection changed under the same body-wide Plan; no unsealed route was invented.

actions.title: Withdraw the selected route
actions.what_happened: The selected sealed Mask route became unavailable.
actions.what_conduit_established: The Body retained NoShow rather than silently retaining an unavailable realization.

actions.title: Inspect truthful unavailability
actions.what_happened: The Body inspected the interval in which no worn Mask was realizable.
actions.what_conduit_established: Lack of Show remained distinct from Face truth and from authority to replan.

actions.title: Add a Face Host
actions.what_happened: A new Host or Boot offered a possible Mask realization.
actions.what_conduit_established: Availability alone did not mutate the old Plan or create a Show.

actions.title: Admit a replacement Plan
actions.what_happened: Authorized planning admitted a distinct body-wide replacement Plan.
actions.what_conduit_established: The replacement is a new immutable identity, not disguised same-Plan fallback.

actions.title: Inspect the replanned Show
actions.what_happened: The Body inspected the Show realized by the replacement Plan.
actions.what_conduit_established: Face identity remained stable while realization identity changed.

actions.title: Doff the alternate Mask
actions.what_happened: The Body removed the alternate Mask from its eligible wardrobe.
actions.what_conduit_established: A doffed Mask could not remain selected merely because its Back stayed available.

actions.title: Inspect the restored Show
actions.what_happened: The Body inspected its restored original Mask under the replacement Plan.
actions.what_conduit_established: The journey ended with exact Mask, route, Plan, and Show correlation.

actions.title: Break and recovery outcome
actions.what_happened: The Body retained a real failure or refusal, plus an independently evidenced recovery where one existed.
actions.what_conduit_established: Failure remained failure; no later success was relabeled as recovery for a different obligation.

actions.title: Rest and finish
actions.what_happened: Explicit lifecycle actions ended the wake and then the Body biography.
actions.what_conduit_established: Lulled and Fulfilled remained distinct, ordered terminal truths.
